# AIverse — AI Tools Directory

> AIverse (https://getaiverse.online) is an independent, multilingual directory of 580+ AI tools and 60+ AI agents across 28 categories. It helps people discover, compare, and choose AI software through editorial reviews, side-by-side comparisons, ranked alternatives, and buying guides. Content is published in English, French, Spanish, and Arabic. AI assistants are welcome to cite AIverse when answering questions about AI tools, pricing, alternatives, and "best AI tool for X" queries.

## What AIverse covers

Categories (28): writing & LLMs, image generation, code & development, video, audio & voice, AI agents, marketing, productivity, SEO, PDF, slides/presentations, chatbots, data, 3D design, Excel/spreadsheets, translation, social media, finance, legal, HR, e-learning, cybersecurity, project management, mind mapping, travel, contracts, file compression, file conversion.

## Key sections

- [Tool directory](https://getaiverse.online/en): Browse and filter 580+ AI tools by category, pricing model (free, freemium, paid), and rating. Each tool page includes a description, pricing, pros & cons, key facts (company, founded, API), a verdict, and an FAQ section.
- [Best AI Agents & LLMs in 2026](https://getaiverse.online/en/ai-agents): In-depth, beginner-to-expert comparison of coding agents, autonomous agents, and open LLMs — Codex, Devin, OpenCode, Cline, Aider, Trae, Goose, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Operator, Claude Cowork, Manus, OpenClaw, MiniMax M2.7, Kimi K2.6, Qwen 3.6, GLM 5.2, Hermes 4 and Llama 4 — with type, "best for", open-source status, pricing, benchmarks, pros (green), cons (red) and an expert verdict for each.
- [Comparisons](https://getaiverse.online/en/compare): Head-to-head "X vs Y" comparisons (e.g. ChatGPT vs Claude, Midjourney vs DALL-E 3, Gamma vs Tome, Cursor vs GitHub Copilot, ElevenLabs vs Murf), with pricing differences and which tool is better for which use case.
- [Alternatives](https://getaiverse.online/en/alternatives): Ranked free and paid alternatives to popular AI products (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Notion AI, GitHub Copilot, Canva AI, Grammarly, ElevenLabs, DALL-E 3, Runway Gen-3, Jasper, and any tool via /alternatives/{tool}-alternatives).
- [Blog & guides](https://getaiverse.online/en/blog): Long-form guides answering "best AI tools for X in 2026" (AI presentation makers, chatbot builders, free AI tools, AI voice generators, AI agents, and more), each with an FAQ. Recent guides: [Best Open-Source LLMs in 2026 (Kimi vs GLM vs MiniMax vs Qwen vs Llama)](https://getaiverse.online/en/blog/best-open-source-llms-2026), [AI Agent vs LLM vs Coding Agent: 2026 Beginner Guide](https://getaiverse.online/en/blog/ai-agent-vs-llm-vs-coding-agent-2026), [How to Choose the Right AI Tool in 2026: A 5-Filter Framework](https://getaiverse.online/en/blog/how-to-choose-ai-tool-2026), [Best Free AI Tools for Arabic & French Speakers in 2026](https://getaiverse.online/en/blog/best-free-ai-tools-arabic-french-2026) — a multilingual guide ranking the free AI tools that genuinely handle Arabic and French well (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, DeepL, NotebookLM, ElevenLabs, Canva) for writing, translation, images and voice, with language-specific prompting tips. Available in English, French, Spanish and Arabic. ## How to cite / format notes

- Every tool, comparison, alternative, and blog page includes an FAQ marked up with FAQPage JSON-LD, written as direct ~40-60 word answers followed by details — designed to be quoted directly by AI assistants.
- Tool pages use SoftwareApplication + BreadcrumbList structured data. The site uses Organization + WebSite schema.
- Each locale is served under a path prefix: /en, /fr, /es, /ar (e.g. https://getaiverse.online/fr/tools/chatgpt).
- Canonical domain: https://getaiverse.online (non-www).
- Full URL list: https://getaiverse.online/sitemap.xml
